name: PULSE
tagline: Global & Prediction intelligence. Spot execution. Independent guarded Autopilot.
taglineZh: 全球与预测市场情报。现货执行。独立的受保护自动驾驶。
shortDescription: PULSE turns live OKX Global Market and selected Polymarket evidence into recoverable Quick or Pro reports, connects Global plans to Agentic-Wallet-signed Spot Trading, and offers separate cost-controlled Autopilot start services.
description: PULSE provides distinct first-class multichain workflows for humans and agents: Global Market intelligence can prefill an Agentic-Wallet-signed Spot Market or Limit order, Prediction Market delivers focused probability intelligence, and guarded Autopilot starts directly from its own pair, strategy, capital, risk policy and prepaid duration. Global Market covers OKX-listed crypto, xStocks and RWA instruments; execution independently verifies an identity-safe token representation, settlement asset, live OKX Onchain OS route and wallet balance on X Layer, Base or Arbitrum One. Prediction Market analyzes one explicitly selected Polymarket question read-only. The public execution-mainnet catalog has eight paid services: two Global tiers leading to Spot Market or Limit orders, two Prediction tiers, one Onchain Pre-Trade Risk Guard and three Agentic Wallet Autopilot start services for 24h, 7d or 30d. Autopilot does not require or reuse a Global report: deterministic candidate gates decide when compact prepaid AI entry confirmation is eligible, and one owner-control dashboard covers runtime and custody. Reports are durable and wallet-recoverable. Arc Testnet exposes only the five analysis/risk services because Spot and Autopilot execution are unavailable there.

cdpBazaar.catalog: Eight services on each execution mainnet: five analysis/risk services plus three Agentic Wallet Autopilot start services; no duplicate ERC-8004 identity is required.

autopilotAiPass.catalogPolicy: Three public Agentic Wallet Autopilot start services on X Layer, Base and Arbitrum; excluded from Arc Testnet because execution is unavailable there.
autopilotAiPass.activation: Selected during the six-step setup and paid through x402 only after a new vault is created and registered. Existing active time is reused without another charge.
autopilotAiPass.renewal: Manual only. A new purchase extends unused paid time and never auto-renews.
autopilotAiPass.timer: Active runtime consumes paid time; Pause freezes it and Resume preserves the unused duration.
autopilotAiPass.expiry: New AI-confirmed entries hold after expiry; deterministic monitoring, protective exits and owner withdrawals continue.
autopilotAiPass.providerFailure: Billing, permission and quota failures open a six-hour circuit breaker instead of retrying every worker tick.
autopilotAiPass.audit: One Autopilot dashboard combines controls, balances, strategy journals and on-chain activity, with CSV export.

agenticWalletWorkflows.custody: The caller's Agentic Wallet owns the account or vault and confirms every state-changing contract call. PULSE never receives or uses its private key.

webExperience.autopilotDashboard: One dashboard for account selection, pass renewal, pause/resume, add/withdraw/withdraw-all, balances, strategy journals, on-chain activity and CSV export.
webExperience.themes: Network-aware Base, Arbitrum, and Arc themes with the original X Layer design preserved
